record.title: Recover stock private-cache acquisition contract
record.intent: Determine a bounded read-only way to preserve stock private state before an ordinary physical option change.
requirements: Pin stock Auklet ancestry and verify relevant disassembly bytes. Recover CFram and MemFile object ownership, cache layout, serialization and flush behavior.
Compare process-memory cache acquisition with device-backed FRAM reading. Identify concurrency, read side effects, missing durability proof and exact physical questions.
Do not contact the specimen or invoke target functions. Preserve private evidence locally and publish only reusable structure and provenance.
acceptance: A concrete acquisition boundary and its limitations follow from verified stock code.
